rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to describe something used to present or introduce information.

example.english: This chart is presentational and is used to introduce the company's new plan.
example.traditional: 呢張圖表係用嚟介紹公司新計劃嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 tou4 biu2 hai6 jung6 lei4 gaai3 siu6 gung1 si1 san1 gai3 waak6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the thing has the format or style of a briefing, slide presentation, or talk.

example.english: This presentational report explains the plan clearly with just a few charts.
example.traditional: 呢份簡報式報告用幾張圖就講清楚個方案。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gaan2 bou3 sik1 bou3 gou3 jung6 gei2 zoeng1 tou4 zau6 gong2 cing1 co2 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this in written or technical contexts when the emphasis is on displaying something for an audience.

example.english: The exhibition's presentational design makes the information easier for visitors to understand.
example.traditional: 呢個展覽嘅展示性設計，方便觀眾理解資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 ge3 zin2 si6 sing3 cit3 gai3 fong1 bin6 gun1 zung3 lei5 gaai2 zi1 liu2
